TEETH: a #[cfg(test)] mod divergent_teeth mirroring exec_tv/body_tv — faithful (x==1 prod==ref) -> Faithful; wrong prod (x<=1 for x==1, the <=-for-== divergence) -> Divergent; frame compile abort (undefined spec-fn req) -> Unverifiable; rlimit discriminator -> kept out of Divergent. Hand-derived verdicts (R-CHAR-3). Faithful corpus path unchanged.
